### Added

- (agent-platform) [Workspace detail page with Sync now and its Sessions](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3184) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Each workspace in Customize's Workspaces tab has its own page: Repositories with their head commits and links, the Sessions working in it with each directory's cleanup date, and Details on its last synchronization and storage. `Synchronize` refreshes it and notifies you when done.
- (agent-platform) [One provider connect prompt for every provider instance](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3185) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The workspace editor and the workspace start in the session composer offer a sign-in button for each Git provider instance you haven't connected, also where there are several, instead of a raw message. Several instances need agent-platform 4.160.0 or later.
- (agent-platform) [Say when an agent's toolset is bound to each session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3193) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — An agent's Toolset card says whether its toolset is `Bound to each session at its start` (agent-manager 2.9.0 or later, where muster trusts the agent's identity) or only declared, which a process in the agent's sandbox can bypass.
- (muster) [Split a connector tool's page into Overview, Run it and Usage tabs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3198) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector tool's page has `Overview`, `Run it` and `Usage` tabs: what the tool does with its input schema, the run form, and the tool's own calls, errors and p95 latency over 30 days. Switching tabs keeps what you typed and a running call.
- (muster) [Link Usage → Connectors rows to each connector's Usage tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3197) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Usage's Connectors view, each connector's name opens its Usage tab with the same time window; an instance of a connector family opens the family's tab, which lists each instance.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [An Organization's agent runs on the platform Harness and is created in its tenant](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3196) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — With Organization tenants on, the new agent wizard creates an Organization's agent in that Organization and offers only the platform Harness there, instead of showing `Could not read the runtimes` and creating the agent in the platform tenant.
- (agent-platform, gs-node) [Read every page of muster's list_tools; tenant servers' tools on their tile](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3194) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — The new agent wizard's Tools step lists every tool muster serves, not only the first 50, so connectors no longer show 0 tools. An Organization's own connectors show their tools on their own tile.
- (gs-node) [Reuse a person's pending muster sign-in, not one per poll](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3195) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — A page that keeps reading a connector you haven't signed in to, such as the workspace-manager, no longer uses up muster's 10 sign-ins a minute, so your own `Sign in` still works.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.16.2...v3.17.0
